about_the_game:
Welcome to the chaotic battlefield of FloorBreaker – where precision shots, quick thinking, and a bit of destruction are the keys to victory!

You and your opponents stand on opposite sides of the arena, with fragile layers of floor beneath your feet. Your mission? Hurl balls to break the ground under your enemies and make them fall – before they do the same to you!

🔹 Core Gameplay

  • Launch balls to smash through the enemy's floor tiles.

  • Symmetrical arenas, no crossing the center line – it’s all about aim and timing.

  • Last one standing wins!

🔹 Unique Characters with Special Abilities

  • A flying elephant, a tongue-lashing chameleon, a frog with a leaf shield… each character brings unique mechanics.

  • Everyone can throw and retrieve balls – but how you play them makes all the difference.

🔹 Crazy Power-Ups & Interactables

  • Exploding balls, time-freeze gadgets, shield repairs, teleporters and more!

  • Most objects in the scene are interactive – flip pans, trigger traps, or launch your opponent with a surprise cannon.

🔹 Satisfying Destruction Physics

  • Each type of floor breaks differently – from wood to metal – delivering crunchy, tactile feedback that you can feel.

🔹 Play Solo or with Friends

  • Battle AI solo, or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in local or online multiplayer mayhem.

Ready to break some floors? Grab a ball, take aim, and send your enemies crashing down in FloorBreaker!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 650TI OR AMD R7 250x
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7-3820 @ 3.6Gh
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Smash through the enemy’s floor in this fast-paced ball-blasting battle! Break the Floor is a physics-driven, high-impact action game for solo players or 1–4 player multiplayer.
